data.gender_notes: Mashahirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'sh-h-r', meaning 'to be renowned' or 'to be famous'. This name holds spiritual significance as it is reminiscent of the many Prophetesses and Righteous Women in Islamic history. The name Mashahirah carries the meaning “Famed, Renowned, Glorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mashahirah usually hope their child will grow to embody famed, renowned, glorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
